run.description: The forkit run this issue belongs to (its slug).

id.description: The issue's own id, as the list shows it: 60, D-12.

desc.description: Two or three lines saying what the issue is about.

prompt.description: The instruction the issue's fork starts with.

root.description: The agentic process every fork of this run is forked from.

status.description: open: being worked; done: finished, its fork closed.

process_id.description: The live fork working this issue; empty until it is first opened.
